inputs.value: {"subject_definitions": "<Picture 1> defines ONE adult woman Mia, her dark-brown half-tied hair and opaque glossy pearl-white/orange fitted cyber suit with flat boots; the three views depict one performer. <Picture 2> defines the COMPLETE rooftop-city set: a large rectangular pale concrete landing plaza, all four detailed perimeter edges, orange rails, cyan inset deck lights and fully constructed glass/metal/ceramic buildings surrounding it on every side. This aerial image is a set-design reference, not the camera angle to copy. <Picture 3> defines Mia's exact face; its views are one identity. <Picture 4> defines the ONE white-orange armored airship, angular cockpit, swept fins, cyan-core nacelles and sealed rectangular side cargo hatch. <Video 1> defines moving-ship geography, camera path, door hinge and character root translation only; unanimated body joints are not performance guidance.", "summary": "The white-orange airship keeps flying forward over the designed city. Its side hatch opens, and Mia steps out and gives a confident lens-directed thumbs-up. Follow <Video 1> for the camera movement and framing.", "retention_analysis": "Preserve the same ONE detailed armored white-orange airship from <Picture 4> at every distance: angular cockpit, segmented hull, swept fins and cyan-core thrust nacelles. Preserve one Mia with the exact face and suit from the pictures, and the complete finished rooftop-city design of <Picture 2>. <Video 1> supplies camera movement, forward flight, root placement and door motion only; its untextured surfaces and shape detail are not the final ship design. Keep the finished armored hull consistent with coherent structure and material detail around the door. The ship continues forward relative to the stationary city throughout, showing background parallax. Replace all proxy surfaces with finished designs, no blank rectangular wall, exposed clay geometry or grey blocks. Create natural steps and hand gesture from text instead of copying the proxy's static joints. Keep hands connected to arms, door bottom hinge stable and one hatch only. Follow the camera movement and framing of <Video 1>. No added text or dialogue.", "detailed_description": "0-0.8 seconds: The white-orange airship is already flying forward above the bright city rooftop. The finished ship stays the same designed aircraft, with its hull, fins and engines coherent. 0.8-2.2 seconds: The side hatch remains closed. Reflective glazing, layered cladding and detailed structures remain visible around it; background architecture slides backward relative to the flying hull. 2.2-3.3 seconds: Hatch unlatches and folds outward/down on its bottom hinge, forming a short solid platform. Mia is revealed in the dark finished cargo interior. 3.3-4.0 seconds: She steps onto the moving platform, briefly supports herself with her LEFT hand on the vertical hatch frame and releases it. 4.0-5.167 seconds: She looks into the lens, smiles playfully, and gives one clearly readable RIGHT-HAND THUMBS-UP at chest height, thumb vertical and four fingers curled. End with this gesture; she does not jump in this short diagnostic clip.", "overall_soundscape": "Continuous forward-flight engines and air rush, a short cargo-latch click and hinge movement, two boot steps on metal, slight suit rustle. No dialogue.", "non_diegetic_music": "N/A"}
